chapter: Chano Pozo, Town Hall and Charlie Parker
title: Chano Pozo leads a percussion jam
summary: At the Nola session Chano organized congas, bongos and timbales and showed his command of the style.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Uh - Huh. All right, now, that day that that picture was taken, Miguelito Valdes is there too. Did you just record Olga or were there other recordings done that day?

I think it was just record Olga; and then the next time was Chano Pozo, so we made like a jam session, tambores, you know, congas, bongos, timbales and Chano Pozo was in charge. That's when you really realized how much Chano knew about that style. He was a good organizer, he know what he want, he give you all the syncopation, all the things that every conga player had to do. The clave, the spoon around the conga barrel and, no no no no, he was a real pro in that particular thing.
